enemy-016-burster.note: Twelve manual longitudinal cranial-shell chords across three comparable lateral poses per clip. The rigid black posterior end-cap and front shell above the jaw are used, not swollen membrane apex, open jaw, tail or pose bounds. Median relative to idle; one scale factor per complete clip. This measures anatomical registration with +/-6px uncertainty and does not certify 1:1 canon or fluidity.

measurements.note: Manually observed posterior black cranial end-cap to anterior shell edge above jaw; excludes jaw gape, expandable membrane apex, tail and limbs. Same lateral chord compared across head pitch; +/-6 source pixels. Active source, coordinate-grid zoom and final cyan marked overlay individually inspected; endpoints confirmed within declared uncertainty.
